notes.title: Free Content Update: Richochet Rumble! (and 1.4.2 Patch Notes)
notes.content:
Surprise!

Are you tired of roaming the same dungeon, bashing the same blobs and hitting the same levers? Well good news, this update brings a fresh new stack of rooms, blobs and levers to roam, bash and hit!

To access the "Ricochet Rumble" dungeon, you will need to go to the Challenges menu and have defeated the second boss in the game. This mini dungeon is not connected to the main game and focuses more on puzzles and precision throwing. It also features new art and a new mechanic. 

Why this update? Well we were inspired to say Thank You to the Batbarian community for their inspiring gifts! Just in the last few months we've been delighted to see [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=12TKZT0OYgk]this[/url] fantastic and hilarious review by The Hidden Chest!

As well as [url=https://soundcloud.com/whodigiya/rapbarian]this[/url] great rap song by Whodigya (Warning it contains story spoilers for those who haven't beaten the game.)

Thanks a bunch to you all for keeping the Batbarian world alive :)
SQUEE!

1.4.2 Patch Notes:

[list]
[*] New Ricochet Rumble Challenge, unlocked by acquiring the "3 for 1" achievement (defeating the 2nd boss in the main game).
[*] Improved Gallery challenge by displaying higher res versions of posters upon interaction.
[*] On PC, the posters can now also be found in your file system at 
[code][game install location]/Batbarian Testament of the Primordials_Data/StreamingAssets/Posters
[/code]
[*] Reordered the list of challenges in the menu to be in the order they are likely unlocked in the course of playing the main game.
[*] Improved behavior of a specific portal in a late game room.
[*] Limited number of times a repetitively bouncing throwable could continue playing sounds over the top of each other, and fixed a calculation for how the volume of that sound is affected by the player's volume settings.
[*] Fixed a save slot bug that could occur when reloading from a campfire before ever sitting at a campfire.
[*] Removed analytics reporting from the game, and the relevant game setting option to enable it (now that the game has been out for a while our updates are small and infrequent enough that this isn't really needed anymore).
[/list]

notes.title: Batbarian: Testament of the Primordials 1.3.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Barbarians and winged companions! Today we're releasing a new mode we've been working on for the last several months, which should be a neat bit of additional content for experienced players! We've added a "Challenges" menu, located on the main menu in game, which contains unique standalone levels to play through. Currently there is a (quite difficult) Boss Rush challenge, unlocked after beating the game with ending A or B, and a Gallery "challenge" in which all the amazing art made by our poster artists for Batbarian can be viewed. The Challenges system allows us to add content to Batbarian without disrupting the flow and balance of the main adventure, so there may be more challenges added in the future as well! Hope you enjoy, we're excited to hear feedback on the challenges ːpuregemː

[h3]1.3.0 Patch Notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new "Challenges" mode accessible from the main menu: [list]
[*]     Special levels totally separate from the main game and from any stats specific to save files.
[*]     Challenges are unlocked based on achievements progress
[*]     Can continue a challenge from an autosave point with the "Continue" button on the Challenges menu.
[*]     Lock icon displayed on locked challenges, as well as icons of required achievements (only one of the displayed achievements is required to unlock the challenge)
[*]     Checkmark appears next to completed challenges
[*]     More challenges may be added in the future. [/list]
[*] Added Boss Rush challenge
[*] Added Gallery "challenge"
[*] Translations for text necessary for challenges mode
[*] Fixed a cutscene early in the game where Drai sometimes wouldn't play a walking animation
[/list]

notes.title: Batbarian: Testament of the Primordials 1.1.18 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello bats and barbarians!

Today, to coincide with our console releases, we've got a bit of an update for you PC players as well! Most noticeable thing will be a slick new animation that can be viewed on game startup! In addition to that we have a number of adjustments that should make a couple parts of the end game go a bit smoother, as well as a retroactive fix for some people who might have not unlocked some achievements properly.

In other news, Trading Cards, Badges and Emotes are on their way! You'll be able to collect them all as soon as they are reviewed by Steam!

ALSO we are finishing up work on the much-requested French translation on the game, so that will be coming very soon as well!

Hope you're all having a great summer, enjoy!

[h3]1.1.18 Patch Notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an intro animation to the game that plays on startup. Can be skipped in the same manner as other splash screens, by pressing the confirm button.
[*] Volume settings are now applied to the splash screen videos.
[*] Added the credits for the intro animation to the credits screen.
[*] Made the unlocked route after defeating one of the late game bosses more apparent.
[*] Hearts spawned during the final boss should no longer fall into inaccessible places.
[*] Adjusted the flow of the cutscene after defeating the final boss.
[*] Moved a torch that was rendering in front of the player to render behind.
[*] Adjusted a room in Polyandrium.
[*] Fixed Spawn being able to be damaged by magic attacks.
[*] Fixed companion names in inventory UI sometimes not being localized properly.
[*] Fixed a couple benign errors in a couple purchasables.
[*] Fixed "Invert" and "Calibrate" text being translated incorrectly in the controller calibration window in some languages.
[*] Check chests, satchel, and gems achievements upon loading a save and opening the inventory, to retroactively fix for people who had an api error unlocking them.
[/list]

notes.title: Batbarian 1.1.13 Update & Autumn sale
notes.content:
First of all, Batbarian is doing it's very first Steam sale starting TODAY! Now's the time to get it for 20% off!

And last but not least, we're also bringing a big batch of improvements and fixes to the dungeon for all you barbarians.

Here's a complete list of update changes: 

- Skip most boss intro dialog on repeat attempts on bosses.
- Opened permanent path to a few rooms and a chest that were previously only accessible once.
- Improved teleportation UI to make it more clear how you select destinations.
- Fixed PS4 and Switch controller icon display when using Steam Configuration Support.
- Fixed critical strike not working on big/small fire/ice elementals, and fire bouncers.
- Can now one shot small fire elementals with ice aura pip strike.
- Fixed the Goddess getting all hitboxes hit simultaneously (good luck).
- Fix for big fire elementals sometimes leaving upside down ground fires after having gone though an area with upside down ground fires. The dungeon gets weird at times but that was a bit too much.
- Removed some confusing switches that were there for "realism" of the place in the ogre fortress but never usable.
- Double/half current hp when changing boosted defense assist (so that you don't get a bunch of empty hearts when activating it).
- Fixed some map areas not displaying the appropriate names on the map.
- Fixed a bug with the regenerating shield of one of the final bosses.
- Fixes for elements of Friffle's shop and kids not maintaining state or getting reset properly when leaving 1 room away and coming back.
- Fixed a lava collider in a late game Mournsalt room.
- Improved exit game and reload confirmation windows fading out when confirming selection.
- Improved some checkpoint positions.
- Improved position of a lever in Darkcross.
- Fixed missing audio source on lethal spikes with switches.
- Fix for some parts of the endgame credits not completely fading out when they should.
- Grammar fixes.

notes.title: Batbarian: Testament of the Primordials 1.1.12 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Got another small update today! Biggest change is a fix for the game not opening properly for some people who had enabled Exclusive Fullscreen mode. This change does mean that players who want to use Exclusive Fullscreen mode (as opposed to Borderless Window Fullscreen, the default), will need to re-enable this setting every session for the time being.

[h3]1.1.12 Patch Notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Prevent launching the game in exclusive fullscreen mode (launch in borderless windowed fullscreen instead, which has always been the default). This was permanently breaking some people's ability to play the game after enabling that setting. People who want to run the game in exclusive fullscreen mode will have to adjust that setting every session for the time being, though it was inconsistent whether it was maintained between sessions anyways.
[*]Fixed publisher splash video not rendering.
[*]Fixed a certain upgrade respawning upon repeat visits to its room.
[*]Improved experience for a late game timing-based platforming puzzle. Adjusted timing, added health refills to allow for more repeat attempts, and removed the need to make a tricky throw after the main puzzle is solved just to unlock a shortcut and way out.
[*]Improved readablity on the intended way to activate a switch in a late game room.
[*]Made spider eye hint indicators in the environment in the late game more visible.
[/list]

notes.title: Batbarian: Testament of the Primordials 1.1.8 Quality of Life Update!
notes.content:
[h3]We've got quite a big update for all you barbarians and bats out there today! [/h3]
There are a number of things people have asked for while playing the game that we've always wanted to support, so we're happy to be able to do that now :)

[h2]Brightness Prompt[/h2]
When starting a new game players will now be prompted to set their brightness setting. This should be helpful for getting players started on the right track for the environment they play the game in, and serves to foreground the fact that a brightness setting exists in Video Settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153018/3c70d948c357762686c4bfeb2f1239dacef91ff5.png[/img]

[h2]Increased Ambient Lighting Assist[/h2]
There is now an additional assist in the game to further increase visibility, for players who continue to struggle with it regardless of the brightness setting.

[h2]Minimap Size Toggle[/h2]
Many people have asked for this and we're happy to say you can now increase the size of the minimap via a toggle input. By default it is Right Stick Click on controller and 'M' on keyboard, but you may have to set the mappings manually in Remap Bindings if you've already played the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153018/8b3c265222b02b6fdfbdae57112fa352478220fa.png[/img]

[h2]Zoom in/out on Map Menu[/h2]
Likewise, you can also now zoom the map out in the pause menu :) The default input mappings are the same as for Minimap size toggle above.

[h2]Dyslexia-Friendly Font Option (English and Spanish only)[/h2]
We've added an option to enable [url=https://opendyslexic.org/]a dyslexia-friendly font[/url] to Game Settings, for English and Spanish :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153018/6c2bd286bcd642a61a3877859e5d9a3933fcf4a3.png[/img]

[h2]Speedrun Timer[/h2]
Now that some people have started routing some parts of the game, it's about time we add an in-game timer! It can be enabled in Game Settings.

[h2]Speedrun Dialog Mode[/h2]
There's a lot of dialog in the game, and while that's one of the main appeals, it can get to be a bit much for people speedrunning the game over and over. There is now an option to enable Speedrun Mode in which you can hold Confirm to continue skipping dialog as fast as possible.

[h2]Bigger Dialog Text Option[/h2]
Especially when playing on a TV far away from the couch, some players might have had trouble reading the dialog. There is now an option to increase its font size!

[h1]Thank you everyone who's been playing the game![/h1]
It's been amazing to see all the feedback from everyone who's been playing. We now have a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/837460/Batbarian_Testament_of_the_Primordials/]Very Positive rating on Steam[/url] (98% positive reviews!) as well as an [url=https://www.metacritic.com/game/pc/batbarian-testament-of-the-primordials]84 on Metacritic[/url]! Thanks for enjoying the game and for giving us feedback that helps us make it even better! The full 1.1.8 patch notes are listed below. See you next update! ːsteamhappyː

[h2]Full 1.1.8 Patch Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Brightness prompt added to the game when starting a new save, allowing players to set their brightness, and call attention to the fact that setting can be changed at any time.
[*]Added an Increased Ambient Light assist, to further assist with visibility for those struggling with that aspect.
[*]Minimap size toggle input binding.
[*]Zoom map in map menu input binding.
[*]Added Game Settings option for Dyslexia-Friendly font, for English and Spanish.
[*]Added Game Settings option for Bigger Dialog Text.
[*]Added Game Settings option for Speedrun Timer.
[*]Added Game Settings option for Speedrun Dialog Mode.
[*]Increased the max level for the main character in the game by 5 additional levels (these 5 levels will be very difficult to achieve without using the XP-related assist).
[*]Reduced "level" of several bosses to prevent getting lots of XP from them when you're already significantly over-leveled.
[*]Added a checkpoint before a particular late game boss that was missing one.
[*]Added a Confirm input icon to Item and Upgrade pickup menus.
[*]Moved second throw tutorial text to be a bit more foregrounded in the room it appears in.
[*]Darker backdrop for confirmation popups, and prevent displaying selection indicator on pause screen while a confirmation popup is open to prevent confusion of where your current highlight is.
[*]Fixed invisible platforms during a late game boss.
[*]Fixed some visual bugs in one of the endings.
[*]Fixed being able to jump into a small hole in Mournsalt that should only be for throwing things into.
[*]Fixed one of the Ending achievements not unlocking in some cases.
[*]Fixed being able to lock yourself behind a door in a late game room.
[*]Fixed many Soul Eaters displaying as 'open' when coming back to a room where they've already been completed.
[*]Fixed a dialog flow bug when meeting Twigs.
[*]Fixed input visual for D-Pad Up on Switch controllers.
[*]Some additional very minor level design tweaks.
[*]A few minor grammar fixes (in English).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153018/de1e4b0b84e9061fb907ff18ea6a150b604ced4b.gif[/img]

[*]Added a checkpoint after a particularly difficult secret room in a chain of secret rooms.

We've got some other improvements planned for future updates as well, so stay tuned! And as a reminder, we also have a [url=https://discord.gg/RsrKxhz]Discord server[/url] if you have questions or want to hang out with the community!

See you all next time!

notes.title: Batbarian: Testament of the Primordials is available NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153018/a0a94a38ca52faa7420304804dbbbcc866f4ec67.png[/img]

This is it! Batbarian is OUT! Sharpen your sword or claws, pack up your fruits and get ready to dive into the abyss!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/837460/Batbarian_Testament_of_the_Primordials/

We're also simultaneously releasing the Original Soundtrack on the store containing a whopping 29 awesome tracks from our amazing composers Will Savino and Derris-Kharlan (and a few guests)! Check it out! 

Also we finally have our own discord server! Come join us to chat about your finds and hangout with us: https://discord.gg/RsrKxhz

SQUEEEE!

notes.title: Steam Festival demo update
notes.content:
Hey all! 
Come get your hands on this freshly updated demo containing the first area and boss of the game. 
Get a taste of a narrative-driven metroidvania praised for its humor, action and puzzles (yes, even as a barbarian you might be required to use your brain)!

This new demo now contains additional languages and we added assists for players who want to experience the game differently.
Last but not least, this is the last event before the game's release on October 15th!!! 
Enjoy!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153018/c8911d7180ca53507627a17a98fe176a592f3389.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Demo is live for Tokyo Game Show!
notes.content:
[h2]Tokyo Game Show Demo[/h2]

We are activating an updated version of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/837460/Batbarian_Testament_of_the_Primordials/]demo[/url] for Batbarian: Testament of the Primordials on Steam for the next several days to coincide with our presence at Tokyo Game Show 2020! If you missed it when it was up before, or you're interested in seeing the updates (including Assists and support for 5 languages!) here's your chance!

[h2]Dev Stream[/h2]

In related news, we're also going to be doing a dev stream tonight at 6pm PDT over on [url=https://www.facebook.com/chyadosensei]ChyadoSensei's stream[/url]. Come watch us play through an hour of the game and answer your questions!

[h2]Poster Artwork[/h2]

Until then, enjoy some awesome artwork by a [url=https://twitter.com/satc_yoshioka/status/1305710141812006913]couple[/url] amazing [url=https://twitter.com/PierrePrinzbach/status/1309167911005683712]artists[/url] we're working with to imagine Batbarian poster art in different styles!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
Hello bats and barbarians! Finally after lots of hard work we are ready to announce that our game [i]Batbarian: Testament of the Primordials[/i] will be coming to Steam very soon... on October 15th! ːsteamhappyː

Here is our updated trailer including the release date:
[previewyoutube=xYpR1WfFocA;full][/previewyoutube]

More details including a full list of platforms can be found on our [url=https://twitter.com/batbarian]twitter[/url].

We are incredibly excited to finally be able to share the full adventure with you all. Thank you to our community for waiting patiently all this time!

Speaking of community, we now have a [url=https://discord.gg/RsrKxhz]discord[/url] where people can discuss the game and stay up to date on all our updates and progress! Come hang out!

notes.title: Dev Live Stream and Q & A
notes.content:
Batbarian: Testament of the Primordials is part of the Steam Summer Festival and for the occasion we'll be sharing some playthrough of areas of the game that are not found in the demo on Thursday the 18th at 5pm PST ! We will also be there to answer your questions in the chat. :)

See you soon!

notes.title: A New Name
notes.content:
[h1]Today we are celebrating two big news! [/h1]

First, you might have seen the name of the game has changed in the store, Batbarian is now known as Batbarian: Testament of the Primordials! It's a bit more of a mouthful but it reflects a bit better the themes and narrative aspects of the game to newcomers. Also, google is a lot nicer to searches with those extra words... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153018/f0adc93b21f313263b6d14cc3b8b90e40c66682a.png[/img]

And lastly, after 4 years, we can finally say that the game is pretty much done! We can finally move from core development to the arduous processes of localization and QA. We do not have a precise release date set still, but we shall announce that soon! :)

Stay tuned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35153018/de1e4b0b84e9061fb907ff18ea6a150b604ced4b.gif[/img]

WEEEEEEEE!
